system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Altaba Inc. realized record, ~2021-2023 window (3-5 years after ~2018)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. This sub-dossier describes ONLY the realized
> 3-5-year record after closing. It contains no information about how the transaction was
> structured at closing.

## Outcome window and source
- The fixed outcome window is approximately 2021-2023 (three to five years after the ~2018
  closing). The registrant remained a public filer through this window: rather than a Form
  10-K, it files a certified annual report on Form N-CSR as a registered closed-end
  investment company. The primary outcome source is its fiscal-year-2021 Form N-CSR (period
  ended December 31, 2021; filed February 11, 2022). [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]

## Realized corporate trajectory (dissolution and wind-down)
- The Board unanimously approved and adopted a Plan of Complete Liquidation and Dissolution
  on April 2, 2019; stockholders approved it at a special meeting held on June 27, 2019. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- On October 4, 2019 the registrant filed a certificate of dissolution with the Delaware
  Secretary of State (effective 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time that day); it closed its stock
  transfer books and ceased to be traded on The NASDAQ Global Select Market. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- On May 28, 2020 the registrant filed a verified petition in the Delaware Court of
  Chancery for determinations under Section 280 of the Delaware General Corporation Law
  (In re Altaba, Case No. 2020-0413-JTL); on August 18, 2020 it agreed to retain an
  aggregate $1.76 billion as security for claims of the IRS, subject to agreed release
  mechanisms. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- By this window the registrant had "sold, distributed or otherwise disposed of
  substantially all of its remaining non-cash assets," and its activities were limited to
  winding up its business affairs; it stated it currently expects to deregister as an
  investment company under the 1940 Act after distributing substantially all of its assets. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]

## Disposition of the former portfolio holdings
- The former minority holdings were monetized: the FY2021 report references the gain on the
  sale of Alibaba Shares in connection with the registrant's 2018 and 2019 tax years, and
  closing agreements with New York State/City tax authorities regarding that gain. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- By December 31, 2021 the schedule of investments held no Alibaba or Yahoo Japan equity;
  total investments of $2,696,856 (thousands, 77.7% of net assets) consisted of short-term
  fixed-income / U.S. Government debt securities. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]

## Realized financial scalars ($ in thousands)
- Net assets applicable to common shares fell to $3,470,092 (thousands) at December 31,
  2021. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- For the year ended December 31, 2021, net (decrease) in net assets resulting from
  operations was $(69,223), comprising a net investment loss of $(69,105), net realized
  gain on investments of $59, and net change in unrealized depreciation of $(177). [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- For the year ended December 31, 2020, net increase in net assets resulting from operations
  was $321,525 (net investment income $247,062; net realized gain $941,942; net change in
  unrealized depreciation $(867,479)). [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]

## Liquidating distributions to shareholders (within the window)
- A pre-dissolution liquidating distribution of $51.50 in cash per share was paid on
  September 23, 2019. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- An Interim Liquidating Distribution of $8.33 per share ($4,327,529,678.78 in the
  aggregate) was paid on November 2, 2020. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- A Partial Final Distribution of $7.48 per share ($3,885,945,017.68 in the aggregate) was
  paid on August 5, 2021. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- A distribution of $0.54 per share ($280,536,137.64 in the aggregate) was paid on
  September 1, 2021, and a distribution of $0.67 per share ($348,072,615.22 in the
  aggregate) was paid on December 30, 2021. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]
- For the year ended December 31, 2021, total liquidating distributions to common
  shareholders were $(4,514,554) (thousands); net decrease in net assets for the year was
  $(4,583,777) (thousands). [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Within the ~2021-2023 window the registrant executed a court-supervised complete
  liquidation and dissolution rather than continuing as an operating or holding entity:
  it had disposed of substantially all non-cash assets (the former Alibaba and Yahoo Japan
  minority stakes were monetized), held its remaining assets in short-term U.S. Government
  and fixed-income securities, and returned capital through successive liquidating
  distributions ($4,327.5M in 2020 and $4,514.6M in 2021), while retaining reserves
  (including $1.76 billion for IRS claims) under a Delaware Section 280 proceeding, with
  net assets reduced to $3,470,092 (thousands) by December 31, 2021. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-22-036939, Form N-CSR (FY2021)]

[SLICE END]
